semantics.attribution: Deterministic evidence attribution describing which eligible signals align with or conflict with the classified market regime. It does not establish causality.
semantics.contribution_share: Relative share of absolute weighted signal evidence among eligible drivers; not causal impact or outcome probability.
semantics.confidence: Reliability of the attribution evidence given regime confidence, coverage, and agreement; not causal probability.
semantics.recommendation: The engine does not emit BUY/SELL/LONG/SHORT/PAY/EXECUTE recommendations.
